assumptions: The training populations are correct and representative of the events to be labelled; every event is forced into one class.
limits: flowDensity's ellipse gate, control-file and margin options are not ported; nu-SVMs are not ported.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which population would a model trained on the gated ones assign each event to, or where does the density put a 2-D gate?

description: Supervised and density gating on a project FCS file: a random forest (R randomForest 4.7) or a C-classification SVM (e1071 / libsvm) trained on the events of two or more of the strategy's populations (each event in exactly one of them, at most N per class drawn by R's sample()) and applied to every event of the parent, with out-of-bag or training confusion and Gini importance; or flowDensity 1.46's 2-D density gate on a channel pair (deGate threshold per channel, kept side, convex hull).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

asinh_a.description: the a in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_b.description: the b in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

asinh_c.description: the c in asinh(a + b·x) + c.

channels.description: comma-separated feature channels; empty for every channel but time.

classes.description: comma-separated populations whose events are the classes (2 or more).

classifier.description: random forest, support-vector machine, or flowDensity.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

gamma.description: the kernel gamma; 0 for 1 / the channel count.

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

mtry.description: channels tried per split; 0 for the square root of their count.

parent.description: the population classified or density-gated; empty for all events.

per_class.description: training events drawn per class (0 all).

side_x.description: flowDensity: the side kept on X.

side_y.description: flowDensity: the side kept on Y.

name: classify_flow_cytometry_events

classes.description: per class: events in it alone, trained on, predicted in the parent

confusion.description: observed × predicted over the training events, and the error

gate.description: flowDensity's thresholds, count, proportion and hull
